definitions.gloss: registered seal; official seal; legal seal
definitions.explanation: A personal seal that has been officially registered with the local government through a process called {印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく}. Used for important legal and financial transactions.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}{契約|けいやく}には{実印|じついん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A registered seal is required for real estate contracts.

examples.japanese: {実印|じついん}を{登録|とうろく}するには{役所|やくしょ}に{行|い}く{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to go to the government office to register your seal.

examples.japanese: {実印|じついん}と{印鑑証明書|いんかんしょうめいしょ}を{持参|じさん}してください。
examples.english: Please bring your registered seal and seal certificate.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{実|じつ} (real, actual) + {印|いん} (seal)

Literally "real seal" - the officially recognized seal.

REGISTRATION PROCESS:
To make a seal your {実印|じついん}, you must:
1. {印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく} - register it at your local {市区町村|しくちょうそん} office
2. You'll receive an {印鑑登録証|いんかんとうろくしょう} (registration card)
3. You can then obtain {印鑑証明書|いんかんしょうめいしょ} (seal certificate) as needed

WHEN REQUIRED:
・{不動産|ふどうさん}{取引|とりひき} - real estate transactions
・{自動車|じどうしゃ}の{購入|こうにゅう}/{売却|ばいきゃく} - buying/selling cars
・{会社|かいしゃ}{設立|せつりつ} - company establishment
・{保証人|ほしょうにん} - acting as guarantor
・{遺産|いさん}{相続|そうぞく} - inheritance matters

SEAL SPECIFICATIONS:
{実印|じついん} typically should be:
・Unique (not mass-produced)
・Larger than {認印|みとめいん} (usually 13.5-18mm)
・Made of durable material

IMPORTANT:
Never lend your {実印|じついん} to others - it can be used to enter into binding contracts in your name.
